new_requested_facts: The seven categories are bird, herbivore, predator, primate, reptile, bear and Petting Zoo animal.
Bear and Petting Zoo animal count unless explicitly excluded.
A bear icon may occur with herbivore or predator icons and does not replace them; Petting Zoo is its own game category.
Only an upgraded Association action allows a donation, and at least 1 association task must have been performed during that same action.

Water/rock illustrations on buildings and standard enclosures do not count as terrain requirements or terrain spaces.

A border space lacks another map space along at least 1 of its 6 sides.
Your zoo comprises your card display, map contents and personal supply.
Any zoo combines these for all players.
